Tender Notice 2017-18 (ICMR Zoonosis Project)
Saturday, 27 May 2017
6113 Hits
The Head of Dept. of Microbiology, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram invites sealed tenders for the following items under "ICMR Zoonosis Project". The tenders in sealed envelope superscribed with name of the item and Department should be submitted in the office of “Dept. of Microbiology, Mahatma Gandhi Institute of Medical Sciences, Sevagram, Maharashtra 442102” latest by
15/06/2017
up to 3.00 PM.
Tender forms can be obtained by sending email to ‘
centralstore@mgims.ac.in
’ or can be downloaded from the institute website (www.mgims.ac.in).
The Purchase Committee reserves the right to reject any or all the tenders without assigning any reason.
Microbiology Department (ICMR Zoonosis Project):
1) CO2 Incubator, 2) Real Time PCR Machine, 3) Laminar Hood, 4) Liquid Nitrogen Containers,
5) Ice Flake Machine

Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
